course.title: BEng Electrical and Electronic Engineering (2027 entry) | The University of Manchester
quotes: A-level A*AA including A* in Mathematics and A in either Physics, Electronics, Further Mathematics, Chemistry or Computer Science.
37 points overall with 7,6,6 in Higher Level subjects, including 7 in Higher Level Mathematics and 6 in Higher Level Physics or Chemistry.
IELTS 7.0 overall, with 7.0 in Writing and 6.5 in all other subskills
Tuition fees for home students will be £10,050 for the 2027/28 academic year.

Tuition fees for international students will be £37,500 for the 2027/28 academic year. For subsequent academic years, the University reserves the right to increase the tuition fee by up to 7% each year
